page.title: Restock sessions
page.intro: A session is one restocking period. Starting a new one ends the previous one, and everything received or sold in between is counted in that session.

sessions.noneOpen: No session is open right now.
sessions.empty: No restock sessions yet. Start one when a delivery comes in.
sessions.name: Session #{number}
sessions.closeDescription: Receives from now on won't belong to any session until a new one starts. Its report stops counting at this moment.

report.label: Session #{number} report
report.empty: Nothing was received or sold during this session.
report.revenueNote: Revenue is what customers paid at each sale.
report.revenueNoteEstimated: Revenue is what customers paid at each sale. ≈ marks items with sales from before prices were recorded, valued at today's price.
report.noSales: Nothing was sold in this session.
report.columnsNote: Start and End are the stock when the session began and ended. Click a column heading to sort by it.

summary.sold: {sold, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of {items, plural, one {# item} other {# different items}} sold for {revenue} over {length}, about {perDay} a day.
summary.soldSoFar: So far, {sold, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of {items, plural, one {# item} other {# different items}} sold for {revenue} over {length}, about {perDay} a day.
summary.versus: That is {percent} {direction, select, up {more} other {less}} per day than session #{number}.
summary.received: {received, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} came in.
summary.soldOut: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} sold out.
summary.notSelling: {count, plural, one {# item you received} other {# items you received}} sold nothing.
summary.soldNoMoney: {sold, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of {items, plural, one {# item} other {# different items}} sold over {length}, about {perDay} a day.
summary.soldSoFarNoMoney: So far, {sold, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of {items, plural, one {# item} other {# different items}} sold over {length}, about {perDay} a day.

notes.revenue: What customers paid. About {perDay} a day.
notes.sold: Across {items, plural, one {# item} other {# different items}}.
notes.perDay: Units sold divided by the session's length ({length}).
notes.received: Everything that came into stock during the session.
notes.sellThrough: Of everything you had (stock at the start plus what came in), how much was sold.
notes.soldOut: Items that sold and were at zero when the session ended.

change.versus: {percent} {direction, select, up {more} other {less}} per day than #{number}

attention.soldOutExplanation: These sold and then ran out, so you may have missed sales. Worth reordering first.
attention.notSellingExplanation: Stock came in during this session and none of it sold.
attention.more: and {count} more, in the table below

startDialog.title: Start a restock session
startDialog.endsCurrent: This ends the session that opened {time}. Everything received from now on is logged to the new one.
startDialog.noCurrent: Everything received from now on is logged to this session, until the next one starts.
startDialog.noteHint: Optional, e.g. the supplier or delivery.

banner.label: Restock session
banner.since: Since {date} ({ago}). Everything you receive is logged to it.
banner.adminHint: Start one to group this delivery's receives for reporting.
banner.sellerHint: Receives still count; an admin can start a session to group them.

compare.lengths: Lengths: {a} vs {b}. Per day divides by each session's length (anything under a day counts as one day), so sessions of different lengths compare fairly.
compare.needTwo: Comparing needs at least two sessions. Start another one when the next delivery comes in.

headline.moved: Session #{b} sold {percent} {direction, select, up {more} other {less}} per day than session #{a}: {paceB} units a day against {paceA}.
headline.same: Sessions #{b} and #{a} sold at the same pace: {pace} units a day.
headline.noBaseline: Session #{a} sold nothing, so there is nothing to measure #{b} against. #{b} sold {pace} units a day.

insights.empty: No sessions yet. Insights appear once sessions have sales in them.
insights.estimatedNote: ≈ revenue includes sales from before prices were recorded, valued at today's price
insights.trendNote: Each bar is that session's average per day, so long and short sessions compare fairly.
insights.unitsPerDayBySession: Units sold per day, session by session
insights.revenuePerDayBySession: Revenue per day, session by session

unsold.title: In stock but not sold in these sessions ({count})
unsold.explanation: Stock that is sitting: {value} at today's prices. Biggest first.

insights.lastMonthEmpty: No session was running in the last 30 days.
